description: Core social feed — posts, likes, comments, and bookmarks. Depends on FEAT-001 (database, auth middleware, upload middleware, and CSS foundations must already exist). Independent of FEAT-003 (profiles/follow) and FEAT-004 (notifications/messages).
steps: Create routes/posts.js. Mount on /api/posts. All write endpoints use requireAuth from middleware/auth.js. Endpoints: GET / — public feed (most recent 20 posts, join users for avatar/username/full_name, include like_count, comment_count, is_liked by current user if session exists, is_bookmarked). GET /feed — requireAuth, posts from followed users + own posts, same joins and counts, paginated with ?page=1&limit=20. GET /:id — single post with full details. POST / — requireAuth, validate content (1-500 chars), optional image via postImageUpload middleware, insert post, return created post. PUT /:id — requireAuth, only post owner can edit, validate content, update post. DELETE /:id — requireAuth, only post owner can delete, delete image file from uploads/ if exists, cascade delete likes/comments/bookmarks/notifications for that post. Helper: buildPostQuery(currentUserId) returns an SQL fragment that selects all post fields plus author info and aggregated counts.

Create routes/likes.js. Mount on /api/likes. POST /posts/:postId — requireAuth, insert into likes (ignore if duplicate via INSERT OR IGNORE), create notification if not self-like (type='like'), return { liked: true, like_count }. DELETE /posts/:postId — requireAuth, delete from likes, return { liked: false, like_count }.

Create routes/comments.js. Mount on /api/comments. GET /posts/:postId — return all comments for a post, join users, ordered by created_at ASC. POST /posts/:postId — requireAuth, validate content (1-300 chars), insert comment, create notification if not self-comment (type='comment'), return created comment with author info. DELETE /:commentId — requireAuth, only comment owner or post owner can delete.

Create routes/bookmarks.js. Mount on /api/bookmarks. POST /posts/:postId — requireAuth, INSERT OR IGNORE into bookmarks, return { bookmarked: true }. DELETE /posts/:postId — requireAuth, delete bookmark, return { bookmarked: false }. GET / — requireAuth, return all bookmarked posts for current user with full post details and counts (same joins as post feed), ordered by bookmark created_at DESC.

Register the four new route files in server.js: app.use('/api/posts', postsRouter); app.use('/api/likes', likesRouter); app.use('/api/comments', commentsRouter); app.use('/api/bookmarks', bookmarksRouter).

Create public/index.html. This is the main feed page. Three-column app-layout. Left sidebar: Connect logo, nav links (Home, Explore, Notifications, Messages, Bookmarks, Profile, Settings) each with an SVG icon, a 'New Post' button, and user mini-profile at the bottom. Top bar: search input. Center column: stories placeholder row (5 circular avatars with gradient rings, static for now), post composer card (avatar + textarea + image-upload button + Post button), feed container div#feed-list. Right sidebar: 'Suggested for you' section div#suggestions-list, 'Trending Topics' section with 5 static placeholder topics. Dark-mode toggle button in topbar. Bottom nav for mobile. Link all CSS files. Script tags: app.js then feed.js.
Create public/bookmarks.html. Same three-column layout as index.html but center column contains only a heading 'Your Bookmarks' and div#bookmarks-list. Script tags: app.js then bookmarks.js.

Create public/js/app.js. This is the shared utility module loaded on every protected page. Exports/provides: apiFetch(endpoint, options) — wraps fetch('/api/'+endpoint, { credentials:'include', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, ...options }), returns parsed JSON, throws on non-2xx. getCurrentUser() — reads from localStorage, returns user object or null. setCurrentUser(user) — saves to localStorage. clearCurrentUser() — removes from localStorage. initDarkMode() — reads 'theme' from localStorage, applies 'dark' class to html element, wires the toggle button #theme-toggle to flip and persist. formatTimeAgo(dateString) — returns relative time string ('2h ago', 'just now', etc.). showToast(message, type) — creates a toast notification div, appends to body, auto-removes after 3s. renderAvatar(user, size) — returns HTML string for user avatar img or initials fallback. confirmDelete(message) — returns a Promise<boolean> using a custom modal (not browser confirm). Called on DOMContentLoaded: checkAuth() (redirects to login if no session), initDarkMode(), load current user from /api/auth/me and store.

Create public/js/feed.js. On DOMContentLoaded: call loadFeed(). loadFeed() fetches GET /api/posts/feed (falls back to GET /api/posts if 401), renders post cards into #feed-list. renderPost(post) returns an HTML string for a post card with: author avatar, full_name, @username, formatted timestamp, post content text, post image (if present) in a responsive container, action bar (like button with heart icon + count, comment button + count, bookmark button, share/copy-link button, more-options dropdown for own posts). Wire event delegation on #feed-list for: like button (toggle like/unlike via DELETE or POST /api/likes/posts/:id, update count and icon state), bookmark button (toggle via API, update icon), comment button (open comments modal), delete post (show confirmDelete modal, call DELETE /api/posts/:id, remove card from DOM), edit post (open edit modal with pre-filled textarea, call PUT /api/posts/:id). Post composer: wire #post-form submit — FormData POST to /api/posts, prepend new post card to feed on success, clear form. Image preview before upload. Suggested users: fetch GET /api/users/suggestions, render follow cards into #suggestions-list with follow button wired to POST /api/follows/:id.

Create public/js/bookmarks.js. On DOMContentLoaded: loadBookmarks(). Fetches GET /api/bookmarks, renders post cards (same renderPost helper, imported via shared app.js globals or duplicated). Wire unbookmark action on each card. Show empty-state message if no bookmarks.
Commit: 'feat(FEAT-002): posts feed, likes, comments, and bookmarks'
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/posts creates a post and it appears in GET /api/posts
GET /api/posts/feed returns only posts from followed users + own posts
POST /api/likes/posts/:id toggles like and increments count; DELETE undoes it
Duplicate like returns 200 (INSERT OR IGNORE) without error
POST /api/comments/posts/:id adds a comment visible in GET /api/comments/posts/:id
POST /api/bookmarks/posts/:id saves bookmark; GET /api/bookmarks returns it
DELETE /api/posts/:id removes post and all associated likes/comments/bookmarks
index.html loads, shows feed, post composer works end-to-end in browser
bookmarks.html loads and shows saved posts
Like and bookmark buttons update their state immediately in the UI without page reload
Image upload on post creation stores file in uploads/ and returns image URL in post data
verification: node server.js — server starts cleanly with routes registered
Open http://localhost:3000 — index.html loads, feed renders (empty or with posts)
Create a post via the composer — it appears at top of feed
Click Like — count increments; click again — count decrements
Click comment icon — comment modal opens; add comment — it appears
Bookmark a post — navigate to /bookmarks.html — post appears there
Open browser devtools console — no JS errors on any of these actions
findings: Implemented all four route modules (posts, likes, comments, bookmarks) with SQL JOINs and aggregated counts — no N+1 queries. INSERT OR IGNORE used for likes and bookmarks. Event delegation wired on #feed-list. renderPost() produces complete post card HTML matching CSS classes from style.css. Post images served from /uploads/. app.js provides all shared utilities (apiFetch, getCurrentUser, showToast, formatTimeAgo, renderAvatar, confirmDelete, initDarkMode). index.html and bookmarks.html implement the full three-column layout with responsive bottom nav. Server starts cleanly on port 3000.
